note: First golden replay of the skill-effect executor: four casters run the eight migrated recipes against dummy formations. A mismatch means cast/effect semantics changed — cast timing (wind-up, decision 0020), geometry resolution (inclusive hits, sweep arc, projectile corridor, burst-includes-struck-target, chain leaps; decisions 0018/0022), damage application via computeDamage, cooldown handling (decisions 0007/0020), or the hostility model (decision 0021) — or an involved skill's or monster's authored numbers changed.
